test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A diamond necklace was to be bought by my wife.

options.text: My wife were to buy a diamond necklace.
My wife was to buy a diamond necklace.
My wife was to buy a necklace of diamond.
My wife was buying a diamond necklace.

solution:
The correct answer is:** 'My wife was to buy a diamond necklace'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The above sentence needs to be converted from **Passive to Active voice.**
 
• The original sentence in passive voice is in** 'Past Indefinite Tense'.**
 
• The grammatical structure of active voice of Past Indefinite Tense is: **'Subject + Verb(past form) + Object'. **
 
• According to the rule of Voice change in passive voice, the object **'my wife'** should be** subject **of the **Active voice**. Then** 'was' **should be used as the **subject** is** singular**. Then **main verb **should be placed. Then the subject of passive voice should be object in Active voice. 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** 'Option 1'**, '**Option 2'**, '**Option 4'** do not follow the structure of **'Past Indefinite Tense'.**
